notes.title: Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
Whoops! Fixed some bugs. Some bugs went unseen while exporting Season 3.
-Fixed issue where winning was impossible in Hallway Top Mode
-Fixed issue where wins, current time, and highscore weren't shown or tracked in Climb Mode
-Fixed issue where floor wouldn't game over in RNG 3D
Thank you for your patience in these matters. Enjoy dodging, weaving, and jumping!

notes.title: Update News
notes.notes:
As you may have seen there are now 45 hidden achievements linked to Dodge & Weave. When the new update comes out these will be available to be seen and unlocked. As of right now there is no way to see them or unlock them.
The new level pack should be launching by the end of May, with new levels to play and big fixes. The update is in the end stages of development and I'm just polishing up the final result and getting trailers ready.
Thank you for your patience and news should be coming soon!
